description: Multi-tier framework for evaluating AI agent skills and plugins with quality gates, security scanning, harness compatibility checks, semantic overlap detection, synthetic evaluation dataset generation, and live agent evaluation that measures how skills affect agent behavior. Ships reusable CI templates that bring every check to any repository.

latest_release.name: SkillEvaluator v1.0.1
latest_release.body:
> 🎉 **Introducing SkillEvaluator v1.0.1, our first complete release in the 1.0 series.**

Understand how your skills load, measure how they perform, and bring automated evaluation into your workflow with **HarnessCheck**, **NeMo Gym integration**, and improved **agent-assisted evaluation and repository CI**.

**[PyPI v1.0.1](https://pypi.org/project/skillevaluator/1.0.1/) · [Download CI bundle v1.0.1](https://github.com/NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator/releases/download/v1.0.1/skillevaluator-ci-1.0.1.zip) · [Documentation](https://docs.nvidia.com/skills/skillevaluator/)**

## Highlights

- **HarnessCheck:** find compatibility issues that can cause your skill to be missed, rejected, or truncated across **Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI, Hermes, OpenClaw, and OpenCode**. Versioned profiles check discovery paths, frontmatter, description and content limits, invocation settings, plugin components, and conflicts with other installed skills. Findings explain what each harness does and how to fix it. Run `skillevaluator harness-check ./my-skill`, or see the results in Tier 1 reports. These static checks need no model key and are advisory under the default policy. [HarnessCheck guide](https://docs.nvidia.com/skills/skillevaluator/harness-check)
- **NeMo Gym integration:** run Tier 3 evaluations with `--backend nemo-gym`, using shared grading and reports. [Required setup](https://docs.nvidia.com/skills/skillevaluator/tier3-runtime#execution-backends)
- **More control over quality:** configure token budgets, description limits, reserved-name terms, and score deductions with `--quality-config`. Use `--profile registry` for stricter author and skill-ID requirements. [Quality rules](https://github.com/NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator/pull/611) · [Registry policy](https://github.com/NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator/pull/499)
- **Clearer reports:** refreshed HTML reports put outcomes, coverage, and next actions first. Improved budget, token, cost, and baseline reporting makes partial or skipped runs easier to interpret. [Reports guide](https://docs.nvidia.com/skills/skillevaluator/reports)
- **Better agent-assisted evaluation:** the updated SkillEvaluator skill guides your agent through installation, preparing cases from real tasks, running evaluations, and interpreting results. Install it with `npx skills add NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator`. Bundled example skills also gain fixes for input fixtures, script handling, and validation. [Agent guide](https://docs.nvidia.com/skills/skillevaluator/agent-skill)
- **More CI options:** add offline pre-commit checks, export JUnit XML with `-r junit`, or use the reusable GitHub workflow for scored PR comments without hosted reports. [Pre-commit hooks](https://github.com/NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator/pull/690) · [JUnit output](https://github.com/NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator/pull/691) · [Comment workflow](https://github.com/NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator/pull/528)

## Add SkillEvaluator to your repository with CI integration

Install or upgrade, then run inside your repository:

```bash
python -m pip install --upgrade skillevaluator
skillevaluator ci init
```

Supports Python 3.12–3.14. Standard quality and security checks need no model key.

CI configuration: [GitHub YAML](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator/v1.0.1/ci/bundles/1.0.1/skill-checks.yml) · [GitLab YAML](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator/v1.0.1/ci/bundles/1.0.1/gitlab-skill-checks.yml) · [Docker image](https://github.com/NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator/pkgs/container/skillevaluator-tier1/1584930975?tag=sha-c9369a7811bde083b550f2ac488222e8c388d7fd).

**Upgrading from v0.9.0:** review the author-policy, security-override, and hook-gate changes in the [changelog](https://github.com/NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator/blob/v1.0.1/CHANGELOG.md). Existing CI workflow and image pins must be updated separately from the Python package.

## New Contributors

- @0z5a made their first contribution in [#519](https://github.com/NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator/pull/519)
- @lucas-saldanha-werneck made their first c

# ![SkillEvaluator](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator/ad2815fe78c045db91d230681d32863698da08cf/docs/assets/skillevaluator-wordmark.svg)

Evaluate and improve AI agent skills and plugins: quality, security, overlap, compatibility, and real impact across agents

[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-Apache%202.0-green.svg)](LICENSE) [![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-3.12%20%7C%203.13%20%7C%203.14-blue.svg)](https://www.python.org/) [![PyPI](https://img.shields.io/pypi/v/skillevaluator.svg?label=PyPI)](https://pypi.org/project/skillevaluator/) [![Reusable CI templates](https://img.shields.io/badge/Reusable%20CI-templates-blue.svg)](https://docs.nvidia.com/skills/skillevaluator/repository-integration#copy-a-template) [![Documentation](https://img.shields.io/badge/Documentation-docs.nvidia.com-blue.svg)](https://docs.nvidia.com/skills/skillevaluator/) [![Paper](https://img.shields.io/badge/arXiv-2608.20614-b31b1b.svg)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.20614) [![Blog](https://img.shields.io/badge/Blog-NVIDIA%20Developer-76B900.svg)](https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/evaluating-ai-agent-skill-performance-with-nvidia-skillevaluator/) [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator)](https://github.com/NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator/stargazers) [![Forks](https://img.shields.io/github/forks/NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator)](https://github.com/NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator/forks)
> 📺 **Livestream:** [Ask the Experts: Evaluating Agent Skills](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4rI0zATFxYI) SkillEvaluator checks AI agent skills and plugins, and measures a skill's effect on task results: start with quality checks, then compare runs with and without a skill. Catch skill issues before merge. Connect your repository to SkillEvaluator with a [CI template](https://docs.nvidia.com/skills/skillevaluator/repository-integration) for automated quality and security gates, without building or maintaining evaluation code. Agent skills are folders of instructions and supporting files defined by the [Agent Skills specification](https://agentskills.io/). SkillEvaluator is part of the [NVIDIA Verified Skills pipeline](https://github.com/NVIDIA/skills). ## Get started Install the CLI in a Python 3.12–3.14 environment: ```bash pip install skillevaluator ```
Or use uv ```bash uv tool install --python 3.13 skillevaluator ```
For uv setup or direct GitHub source installation, see [Installation](https://docs.nvidia.com/skills/skillevaluator/installation). Then check skills from your terminal, CI, or agent:

Run checks backed by **500+ static rules and detection patterns**, without an LLM key. Complete [scanner setup](https://docs.nvidia.com/skills/skillevaluator/installation-options#system-tools) for full coverage: ```bash skillevaluator validate \ ./my-skill --tiers 1 ```
Run all three tiers After [all-tier setup with NVIDIA Build](#run-all-three-tiers-with-a-free-nvidia-build-key), remove `--tiers 1` to add deduplication and live agent evaluation to measure skill lift: ```bash skillevaluator validate \ ./my-skill ```

Check every skill change. Run in your GitHub repo to open a setup PR: ```bash skillevaluator ci init ``` **Start here:** [Guided setup for GitHub and GitLab](#bring-skill-evaluation-to-your-repository).

Add the skill to Claude Code, Codex or another agent: ```bash npx skills add \ NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator ``` Then ask: *"Is my skill any good?"* See the [agent guide](https://docs.nvidia.com/skills/skillevaluator/agent-skill).
### ⚡ [Harness check](https://docs.nvidia.com/skills/skillevaluator/harness-check): will your agent load your skill? 🔑 **No API key** · 🤖 **No agent run** ```bash skillevaluator harness-check ./my-skill ``` Illustrative summary of versioned profiles. Full output can include notes and schema diagnostics. ```text ╭─ Harness compatibility · my-skill ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮ │ ⚠️ codex degraded Description cut to 1,021 chars + '...' in the skill list │ │ ❌ claude-code not loaded .agents/skills is not scanned │ │ ✅ opencode loads │ │ ✅ hermes loads │ │ ✅ openclaw loads │ │ ❌ copilot-cli not loaded description is 1,028 UTF-16 units, 4 over the 1,024 limit │ ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── ❌ 2 of 6 not loaded ─╯ ``` `skillevaluator validate` includes Harness Check in Tier 1 alongside **quality, schema, version, PII, license, Unicode and script linting**. Security and code integrity checks use **SkillSpector, Gitleaks, Bandit and optional Semgrep**. [See all Tier 1 checks](https://docs.nvidia.com/skills/skillevaluator/tier1-reference#the-checks); use `--tiers 1` to run only this tier. 🧪 **Ready to go deeper?** Try a [live agent evaluation](https://docs.nvidia.com/skills/skillevaluator/tier3-live-evaluation) (Tier 3). ## Quickstart ### Check your skill without a key ```bash skillevaluator quality-check ./my-skill ``` No API key, scanner, GPU or Docker is needed. It prints a score out of 100 with a grade and the findings behind it; the passing threshold defaults to 70. This is static quality only; publication evidence stays `INCOMPLETE`. Security and agent impact need additional checks. See the [keyless walkthrough](docs/quickstart.mdx#run-without-an-llm). No skill yet? Clone the repository and use the bundled `src/skillevaluator/tier3/reference_skills/text-analyzer`. Scores can differ by release. ### Run all three tiers with a free NVIDIA Build key Eligible NVIDIA Developer Program members can use NVIDIA-hosted endpoints for **free prototyping**, subject to [access terms and rate limits](https://docs.api.nvidia.com/nim/docs/product). 1. Sign in at [build.nvidia.com](https://build.nvidia.com/) and complete enrollment. 2. Open a model page, select **Get API Key**, and generate your key. 3. Complete [scanner setup](docs/installation-options.mdx#system-tools), start Docker, and [prepare a reviewed dataset](docs/prepare-dataset.mdx). Install every tier, set the provider and key, then validate: ```bash python -m pip install "skillevaluator[all]" export SKILL_EVAL_LLM_PROVIDER=nv_build export NVIDIA_API_KEY='nvapi-...' skillevaluator validate ./my-skill ``` Without `--tiers`, `validate` runs all three. The key covers embeddings and chat in Tier 2 and supported agents in Tier 3; add `--llm` for model checks in Tier 1. For uv or GitHub installations, use the matching [all-tier install](https://docs.nvidia.com/skills/skillevaluator/installation#all-tiers) instead of the pip command above. Tier 3 also needs Docker running; add `--tiers 1,2` to skip it. More in [Run the combined pipeline](#run-the-combined-pipeline), the [Build walkthrough](docs/quickstart.mdx#use-nvidia-build) and [provider configuration](docs/configuration.mdx). ## Bring skill evaluation to your repository > **Start here: [Repository integration guide](https://docs.nvidia.com/skills/skillevaluator/repository-integration)**, > install to first passing check on GitHub or GitLab. Below is the summary. **Minimal setup. No evaluation code to write or maintain.** Choose your skill folders and thresholds to get automated validation, security scanning and downloadable reports for changed skills in GitHub or GitLab. **[11 CI checks](https://docs.nvidia.com/skills/skillevaluator/tier1-reference#the-checks) backed by 500+ static rules and detection patterns:** quality, schema, version, PII, license, Unicode, script linting, [Harness Check](https://docs.nvidia.com/skills/skillevaluator/harness-check), security, code integrity and dependency auditing.
**Scanners:** [SkillSpector](https://docs.nvidia.com/skills/skillevaluator/tier1-reference#security--vulnerability-scanning), [Gitleaks, Bandit and Semgrep](https://docs.nvidia.com/skills/skillevaluator/tier1-reference#code-integrity--code-risk-secrets-and-hygiene), and [pip-audit](https://docs.nvidia.com/skills/skillevaluator/tier1-reference#dependency--cve-audit-opt-in). **GitHub guided setup:** after [installing the CLI](#get-started), run inside your checked-out repository: ```bash skillevaluator ci init ``` Choose checks and optional hosted feedback, then review the setup PR. [CLI setup guide](https://docs.nvidia.com/skills/skillevaluator/cli-onboarding). **Manual setup (no CLI):** copy a filled-in template from [CI templates](ci/bundles/README.md). | Your repository | Ready-to-use template | Copy destination | | --- | --- | --- | | GitHub | [Skill checks](https://github.com/NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator/blob/main/ci/bundles/1.2.0/skill-checks.yml) | `.github/workflows/skill-checks.yml` | | GitLab | [Skill checks](https://github.com/NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator/blob/main/ci/bundles/1.2.0/gitlab-skill-checks.yml) | `.gitlab-ci.yml`, or merge into your existing pipeline | | GitHub PR comments without hosting | [Optional comments](https://github.com/NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator/blob/main/ci/bundles/1.2.0/comment-skill-checks.yml) | Second workflow; complete [comment setup](https://github.com/NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator/blob/main/ci/bundles/1.2.0/README.md#pr-comment-setup) | | GitHub hosted reports and PR comments | [Optional publisher](https://github.com/NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator/blob/main/ci/bundles/1.2.0/publish-skill-reports.yml) | Second workflow; complete [publisher setup](https://github.com/NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator/blob/main/ci/bundles/1.2.0/README.md#one-time-publisher-setup) | Pick one optional feedback workflow. These run Tier 1 checks without a model key; [all-tier CI setup](https://docs.nvidia.com/skills/skillevaluator/advanced-ci) adds deduplication and live agent evaluation. Also: [template reference](ci/templates/README.md) and [report examples](ci/examples/README.md). ## Three-tier overview ![Three-tier pipeline: skill, validation, deduplication, live evaluation, reports](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator/ad2815fe78c045db91d230681d32863698da08cf/docs/assets/three-tier-overview.svg) Each tier is independent. Use the [all-tier installation](https://docs.nvidia.com/skills/skillevaluator/installation#all-tiers) for all three: | Tier | Question | Example after setup | Additional setup | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Tier 1: Validation | Is the skill safe, well-formed and [harness-compatible](docs/tier1-reference.mdx#the-checks)? | `skillevaluator tier1 ./my-skill --no-llm` | External scanners for full static coverage; a provider and model clients enable LLM checks | | Tier 1: Harness Check | Will the agent load the skill? | `skillevaluator harness-check ./my-skill` | No API key or agent run | | Tier 2: Deduplication | Does guidance repeat or overlap? | `skillevaluator tier2 ./my-skill` | Embeddings and chat; add `--catalog ./skill-catalog.json` for inter-skill comparison | | Tier 3: Live Agent Evaluation | Does the skill help the agent? | `skillevaluator tier3 ./my-skill` | Provider access, a supported agent, and a running sandbox (Docker by default) | Prepare [scanners](docs/installation-options.mdx#system-tools) for your installed release; Semgrep is optional. `--no-llm` does not remove scanner requirements; a scanner that cannot run is `INCOMPLETE` and exits nonzero. [SkillSpector](https://github.com/NVIDIA/SkillSpector) provides specialized skill security scanning; [Harbor](https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor), the open-source agent evaluation framework, powers sandboxed agent runs. Tier 2 reports when inter-skill comparison did not run. Tier 3 autopilot reuses sources or creates one skill-grounded case with limited coverage. See [tier guides](https://docs.nvidia.com/skills/skillevaluator/). ## Run the combined pipeline After setting up the provider, scanners, and agent sandbox, run all three tiers: ```bash skillevaluator doctor --env-mode docker skillevaluator validate ./my-skill ``` `doctor` checks readiness, not inference success. `validate` runs all tiers with autopilot for skills. Use `--tiers 1,2` to skip live evaluation or `--tiers 1` for static checks. `--no-autopilot` requires an existing source. Other artifact types retain their applicable stages. Tier 1 gates `validate`. Tier 2 gates unless `--no-block-on-dedup` is set; Tier 3 gates only with `--block-on-agent-eval`. Model and managed-sandbox usage can incur charges; see [runtime and cost](docs/tier3-run-reference.mdx#plan-for-cost). Standalone generation needs substantive `evals/EVAL.md` guidance, a `--prompt` file with task requests and outcomes, or matching retained traces. `--force` below replaces the autopilot starter; `--refine` refines it. Explicit `--grounding skill` permits skill-only starters. Review cases; templates omit unauthored negatives. ```bash skillevaluator tier3 create-eval-dataset ./my-skill --full --prompt eval-guidance.md --force ``` ## Run from a source checkout For an editable environment, follow the [development setup](docs/developer-guide.mdx#set-up-a-development-environment). ## Research and citation Resources: [paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.20614), [PDF](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2608.20614), [DOI](https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2608.20614), [BibTeX](https://arxiv.org/bibtex/2608.20614), and [NVIDIA Developer blog](https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/evaluating-ai-agent-skill-performance-with-nvidia-skillevaluator/). Cite the paper and record the SkillEvaluator release or commit; see [CITATION.cff](CITATION.cff). ## Documentation See [the documentation](https://docs.nvidia.com/skills/skillevaluator/) for setup, tier guides, reports, CI integration, CLI reference, and [performance dashboard](docs/reports.mdx#performance-dashboard). ## Installation and third-party software This project will download and install additional third-party open source software projects. Review the license terms of these open source projects before use. ## Contributing Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) and run: ```bash make lint && make test && make build ``` See [project governance](GOVERNANCE.md) and [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). ## Support Support level: **Experimental**. Community-supported, best-effort, with no SLA or NVIDIA enterprise support entitlement. Report bugs and feature requests through [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator/issues); see [SUPPORT.md](SUPPORT.md). ## Security Report suspected vulnerabilities using the private process in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). Do not disclose security issues in a public GitHub issue. ## Releases See [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) and [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator/releases). ## License Apache License 2.0: see [LICENSE](LICENSE), [NOTICE](NOTICE), and [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).
